summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community include updates on the integration with Spark, particularly regarding features in Spark 4.1 and 4.2. There are ongoing efforts to address LICENSE issues that are blocking the release of versions 1.11 and 1.10.2, alongside proposals for enhancements to the REST catalog and encryption framework.
highlights: LICENSE issues blocking Iceberg 1.11 and 1.10.2 releases
Proposal to integrate HashiCorp Vault as KMS
Discussion on generic CatalogObjectIdentifier for REST spec
